T.description: array of shape ``(..., N, N)`` containing the real Schur form of the input.
constraints: T and Z must have the same N

Z.description: array of shape ``(..., N, N)`` containing the corresponding Schur transformation matrix. Batch dimensions are broadcast with those of ``T``.
constraints: T and Z must have the same N

output.description: A tuple of arrays ``(T, Z)`` of the same shape as the inputs, containing the Complex Schur form and the associated Schur transformation matrix.

constraints: T and Z must have the same N
